answer: Resist sybils by making each registration a sequential voyage through a verifiable delay function whose required length equals one plus the number already accepted. The proof is a short plume of checkpoints, and difficulty follows a spiral that grows with each newcomer. Each challenge has a fresh nonce, so no solution is shared. Registering n identities costs n(n+1)/2 sequential steps total; reward is at most nR, so cloning is unprofitable beyond finite n. Assumption: the registry enforces the length rule; a coalition that forges VDF proofs is the weakness.
